nativeRoute: CS Workspace OAuth2 Password Bearer / native JSON login

loginFlow.steps: 先复用 CS_WORKSPACE_TOKEN；缺失时用户在 CS Workspace 自身登录页登录，或授权凭据注入 POST /api/v1/auth/token（form）/api/v1/auth/login（JSON）。这份 owner 契约未声明 Casdoor/飞书桥。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: LDAP-authenticated local user receives Bearer JWT; JWT sub is local username. Existing browser localStorage consumption does not authorize cache harvesting or token disclosure.
subjectPermission: GET /api/v1/auth/me owner contract matches source /auth/me under settings.API_V1_STR; signature/expiry and username lookup return UserResponse numeric id, username and groups. Scope numeric id to service/environment, bind JWT username privately; deployment prefix/OpenAPI remains pending. Groups do not attest operation/resource permission; current active-user dependency does not enforce is_active and PERMISSION_CHECK_DISABLED is deployment-specific.
expiryRevoke: JWT expiry uses ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES; effective value is unknown. Registered POST /auth/logout returns frontend logout success only; JWT blacklist is future work, and no actual refresh/revocation handler was found. Legacy Flask Redis-jti logic is not a current capability.
